title: HapticDeviceCommand
description: Wire format the sleeve firmware receives (Electronics team's spec, v1.1; extended in v1.2 with cue "stroke" and play_at_ms). One JSON object per UDP datagram (or per BLE write). The software maps clinical cues to this; see contracts/HAPTIC_PROTOCOL.md.

motor.description: 0 = upper arm, 1 = forearm (Phantom Hand Node A: 0 = motor A near the wrist, 1 = motor B 10 cm toward the elbow), 2/3 = additional channels (physical placement TBD; see docs/ELECTRONICS_HANDOFF.md). Extended from [0,1] on 2026-09-19 by user decision.

intensity.description: Wire range stays 0-255 (v1.1 clients). The v0.5.0 firmware caps every value at 150 (3 V coin motors on the 5 V rail); the Phantom Hand game sends round(150 x haptic_max_intensity), so never above 150.

cue_id.description: optional; echo it in the ack so the app can measure latency

cue.description: optional clinical label, for the firmware's own logging only. "stroke" = one Phantom Hand brush stroke pulse (v1.2).

play_at_ms.description: optional, v1.2, informational: the game clock time (ms) the stroke is meant to land. The firmware ignores it (the game times its own sends); it is logged for timing analysis.
